verdict.rationale: llamafile bundles whisperfile, an on-device whisper.cpp-based speech-to-text tool that transcribes and translates audio files, satisfying the on-device model requirement, but the evidence only describes file-based transcription, not real-time streaming dictation UX. missing for 10: evidence of real-time/live microphone dictation, latency/streaming performance, and integration into an interactive dictation workflow rather than batch audio-file transcription.
